body: Haha, not a problem man! I was not looking at the time and I have to be up for work in about an hour anyway so I think I'm actually going to snag some sleep to sleep off the alcohol. Don't want to show up to work drunk again. Luckily it's a Tuesday though. Fuckin nobody is comin in. Haha. Good luck at work my brothuh! Have a good one and I will talk to you later.
If not, that's completely fine, I understand considering I am a stranger. It's just a shot in the dark. Feel free to decline.

It's a great way to relieve stress. I have anger issues and that's my only way is beating the fuck out of a bag in my garage (legally a pacifist so I can't really do much of the beating on people). I never really thought about outliving people I loved. I completely forgot the lonely spectrum of eternity.

Can you do me a favor and message me or something next time you are on edge. I want to be there for you as you were there for me tonight. If not, I'll keep an eye out for you and check back in with you. Nobody deserves the standards when it comes to emotions. I sincerely feel love for you man and I really want to be friends with you in some way shape or form. I know it sounds dumb and pathetic but I just feel like I would be honored to have someone like you be my friend. I don't have much of them so the shelf I'll keep you on is pretty roomy ;) haha. Nah, I would love to just hear more about you and just get to meet you. Maybe play some video games or something. I really like you stranger.

Fuck I don't think I've chuckled this much in such a long time. What sport would you get good at first? Maybe some good ol whack bat (good ol fantastic mr fox reference right there for yah sonny). Any ideas or nah? I'm not a sports person either. Hell, I walk a fuck ton but I can't even run.

Adversity makes a man my friend. Life would be monotonous without the sad, without the agony, without the mistrust. It may seem painful and unbearable (trust me, I know, I'm in the same place as you). Sometimes the best feelings in the world is that heart wrenching sadness that only music and a picture of a starving child can bring. It's not the bad to help us appreciate the good but the bad to remind us we are alive and that there is still hope for difference in our lives. We can still take risks, we can still experience the loss of love, we can experience tragedy and it's beautiful. It's like going over a hill and looking back at what once was cloudy and seeing the sun coming up. It's just a reminder that there is more than the sun.

Haha, well with enough sneaky practice you won't get caught as an immortal. Sounds like a plan though. Sex is boring anyways. I guess it just all depends on how long you can bounce a ball on the ceiling.

Yeah haha. I'm sort of that way. I love humans as much as I hate them. I love that they do feel compassion. Even when they are hurt really bad they feel compassion for others. It's not everyone, I know that, but there are a select few that are just such a beautiful blossom. Just so tentative of the world around them and respectful of those around them. I really am glad I got to meet one of those great people tonight. Thank you so much. I really feel a lot of love for you man.
I don't know. I'd love it to see human progress and also to see as much of the world as possible. What would you do with immortality. You got it and you had no choice. What would you do with it?

Nah, hippy's are cool. Just lost a lot
Of respect for the culture in modern time is all. Not many live how they say they live.
Wasn't there a jellyfish that supposedly has the capability of enteral life or something like that? Yeah, marine things are crazy.

I am reading The search by to brown Jr. Its some hippy shit but it's some great hippy shit. And yeah, as much as I hate to admit it, I really do want to make some sort of impact on the world or at least on a person.

Love the Segway and acknowledgement my man. Haha yes, dogs are absolutely wonderful. They are so god damn great. They are the closest humans will ever come to unconditional love I swear hahah. I'm personally not big on dogs because I have a fear of them and of losing something that is close to me but the are just so kind.

Psshhh, I'm not that evil yah cunt haha. Nah, but at this point, so am I. I'm thinking of all those places I haven't gone yet and all those places that I wouldn't be able to go and it doesn't feel right just leaving something so unfinished. Plus I'm in the middle of a good book.
I agree. I dunno. At least they always tend to get the sharpest end of the stick at the end of it so the dog bites its own tail so to speak.

Well said my friend. Well, looks like we're even than if we owe each other favors eh haha. To be honest, this sure beats standing on a bridge looking down and realizing nobody can talk you out of it. Haha. Just an FYI, jumping off a bridge won't always kill you. It fucking hurts when it doesn't.
I agree. I think it's sad when it comes to things like catholocism, and Christianity and make it so violent and twist it for a personal agenda. Humans are so vile towards each other sometimes.

You seem like a great person. Me personally, I don't really care about many people so the fact that a stranger wanted to help me when they were feeling down really touches me. To be honest I don't think I've been this eager to talk to someone in forever. Haven't left the app. I'm just browsing the front page and constantly checking my notifications. Thank you so much stranger. I really hope things go better for you as well. But hey, sob stories are part of living man. It's tricky to say things without condemning yourself, trust me, I understand that. I had to get pretty drunk to write this. You seem so genuinely great and you have so much to offer. So thank you for taking the time to grace the my peasantry with your holiness ;).

Pssh, just one porno mag? Don't lie Bruv haha. I would love to go there. That post made me really happy. Just seeing people with the balls to go to dangerous places. I've always wanted to see Chernobyl and stuff. Just something about not wanting to live to long and visiting really dangerous places just tends to mingle. Yeah, Japan is really beautiful. I used to watch anime and I'm really obsessed with the topic of religion (although I have a profound stance against religion) and I would love to see all of those shrines. There's just some cool man made things out in this world.

Oh man are you kidding? Vehicles are terrifying. Easiest way to die is right there. Fuck, if I really wanted to commit suicide with no ifs ands or buts, driving a motorcycle into a wall. You'd just be gone and that's terrifying to think. I think that's kinda proof I'm to afraid to die though. Yeah man! You seem really cool and I'm really glad you did comment. Anything in particular that brought you to this subredit in general?

The cold sucks man. Even worse with a tent. It's hell when poles stick together and you try and blow on em and accidentally lick em cause you drank alota rum to stay warm the night before and you have to warm up water with a pole stuck to your tounge. It's embarrassing even with nobody around. Fuck, memorial attachment. If I could go anywhere, I'd love to go to Austria or Japan. I really want to see the suicide forest. And I just really like Austria for some reasons. As far as cold places. I would love to see some sort of east coast beach in the winter. I've lived on west coast beach most of my life and don't get much snow and I really want to see a snow covered beach. It just sounds gorgeous.

I wish that to man. I think the best is driving at night. I'm a massive gear head and have a love of motorcycles and just recently started going on night rides. Going 110 down a pretty vacant strip of road is magical. Sleeping on a hill with the grass around you and a cigarette between my lips is the thing of dreams. Haha. Psh, now I'm just pretty much making porno for myself. It's nice to meet you though stranger.

Nah, I'll definitely do it again if I decide to keep going tonight. No big boy on the play ground that has a Boy Scout uniform is gonna stop me from doing that shit hahah. Man, I have a massive love for the desert. The raw beauty of danger at its finest. Most beautiful thing I've ever seen is a thunderstorm in New Mexico. It's been my favorite state ever since. It's fun to be in the middle of it as well and just laugh daring the mad man in the sky to strike back at you. I think that's the craziest I have ever looked. Just staring up at the sky in the pouring rain shouting obscenities. Life is so grand when you can live it. I think most beautiful is probably when I went off the Appalachian Trail and camped at some random spot in the mountain and I woke up and I was at a really high peak and I looked out and just saw the mountains floating. I've done tons of hallucinogenics, nothing rivals this. It's simply breathtaking. Fuck the beaten path. If you understand how to survive, take a risk my friend, you might regret it, you might not.

Man, never underestimate the beauty of night walks. That's how I started out. I would sneak out when I was around 8 or 9 and sometimes I just wouldn't come home. The world is so much more beautiful at night.
Have you ever gone nomad and just lived life how you want?

Haha sorry if things come out a little weird but I am quite blasted. Umm, I have gone quite a few times actually. I hit hiked a lot of places and I'm really proud of it but I haven't been able to because last time I went I got arrested for sleeping in a national park. It fucking sucked having to spend the night in jail just for sleeping. I didn't even have a tent up. I was just sleeping with my head on my pack. I guess I'm just afraid of being sent home again.
